methods.name: Kolmogorov-Smirnov test with reference-distribution parameters (one- and two-sample)
methods.reference: stats::ks.test (exact = FALSE for the pinned p-values)
quantities: asymptotic p (one-sample two-sided and one-sided; two-sample one-sided)
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md: statistics Tol::stat(n), p-values Tol::p_value(n), n = 5-60

deviations.quantity: exact p-values (one- and two-sample); two-sided two-sample asymptotic p
deviations.note: p2a has no exact distribution and applies Stephens' factor; R values in *_p_exact and two*_p_asym
p2a refuses; ks.test evaluates a point mass (sd = 0) or warns and returns NaN
